audience_question: What does the pilot evidence support the steering group doing next?
fit_rationale: The pilot gives only summary figures (median +6%, range -3% to +14%, 12 of 18 plots positive) and no per-plot values, so a dot or bar chart of plots would have to invent data. The steering group's real choice is between a small set of next steps measured against the same evidence criteria, which is what a semantic comparison table shows. Denominators (18 plots, 12 of 18), units (%), scope, and the unmeasured cost and energy use stay visible as text.
tradeoff: The table is denser and gives the +6% less visual weight than a single headline chart would. It makes the options and missing measures explicit at the cost of making the magnitude and spread of the result harder to see at a glance.
caveats: One winter growing cycle, 18 plots at 3 sites; the pilot size and duration limit how far the result generalises.
The +6% is the reported median yield difference versus each site's reference plots, not a measured effect of lighting.
Individual plot differences ranged from -3% to +14%; 12 of 18 plots were positive and 6 were not.
Plots were not randomly assigned; crop mix and baseline conditions differed between sites.
Installation cost and energy use were not measured, so yield alone cannot support a wider installation decision.
The steering group can decide whether to run another measurement cycle; wider installation has not been approved.
